findings.summary: Exact claimed-branch fetch and binding protects ensure and verification.
Retired-path reuse is atomic and audit reports the active registration.
The permanent control singleton repoints through a journaled recoverable transaction.
Retirement requires exact server-branch proof and never trusts stale local refs or local-only tags.
Audit reports registry drift and lock state without silently adopting unrelated worktrees.
Ephemeral verification uses a per-invocation lease with concurrency refusal, controlled release, recovery, and redacted audit output.
Runtime command, requested sparse scope, and live sparse scope are validated before lease, execution, or lifecycle mutation.
Close proof excludes only the fixed runtime-inert receipt and evidence tail while retaining exact byte checks for every reviewed implementation path.
